concerns.text: The plan cites streaming polymer degradation records from the **WebBook CSV** at `https://huggingface.co/datasets/Raziel1234/WebBooks-1/resolve/main/books_dataset.txt`. This dataset is a collection of books/text and does not contain polymer degradation records or SMILES strings, making it inappropriate for the research question. A suitable open dataset (e.g., the Polymer Genome, Open Polymer Database, or a curated collection of polymer degradation experiments) should be used instead.
